message.reasoning: We need to fill fuel tank. We have function fillFuelTank. Need to determine how much to add. The tank capacity is 50 gallons. We need to know current fuel level. We displayed fuel level earlier: 10 liters. But we need to convert to gallons? The function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we need to convert 10 liters to gallons. Use liter_to_gallon. Then compute remaining capacity: 50 - current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We only know 10 liters. Convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity: 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. So we need to add ~47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount: 47.36.
